oneLiner: A personal tutor built around a child's dream, from real lessons an agent finds on the web.

problem.person: Andy, 11, dreams of going to Mars.
problem.text: His class moves at the pace of 25 others; good lessons online are scattered, unchecked.

stake.text: A Brussels secondary class: one teacher, every level at once.

built.text: Tutor Studio: seven questions, and an agent builds a tutor with lessons and a voice.

how.title: How it works
how.headline: The child says what they dream of; H finds the lessons; the tutor teaches and remembers.

demo.text: Andy creates his tutor, then asks it for his first mission.
demo.fallback: If H is slow, this is the tutor it built for Andy today.

next.works: Tutor Studio, Tutor Room, Gradium's voice and the skill.md brain.
next.missing: The teacher's class view and visible safety screening.
next.then: Families at €9.90 a month; any agent can use a tutor's skill.md.

close.line: Every child's dream deserves its own teacher.
